description: Show the selected Vault, every Vault this account can use with its name and ID, permissions, the project file path (config_file), and local pending or blocked save IDs. Use it to find a Vault ID before writing the project file at the user's request. Recovery paths contain local data that needs explicit review; this tool does not import, retarget, delete, or resubmit it. It does not reveal pending content or another connection's Vault identity.
name: ragionex_memory_connection
title: Check Vault connection and pending saves
